entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: A pantheon of gods of Amonkhet that predated Nicol Bolas; only the Locust God and Scarab God remain, seeking to revive their dead siblings.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker whose reign replaced the Chitin Court's names with foul visages.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: Surviving god of the Chitin Court.

entities.name: Scarab God
entities.description: Surviving god of the Chitin Court.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: Deceased member of the Chitin Court.

entities.name: Fly God
entities.description: Implied member of the Chitin Court, possibly deceased.

entities.name: Wasp God
entities.description: Implied member of the Chitin Court, possibly deceased.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: Event after which the Chitin Court gods remained reduced but divine.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: Place near which cults of the Chitin Court linger.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: Region haunted by the Chitin Court's undead worshippers.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Lazotep-enhanced undead among the Chitin Court's worshippers.

events.summary: The two remaining gods of the Chitin Court seek the remains of their dead siblings to revive them.
events.quote: The two gods of the Chitin Court seek the remains of their long-dead siblings to revive them.

events.summary: The gods wait and plot, gathering legions of the pre-Bolas dead, intending to take back the plane they built.
events.quote: Only then will they take back the plane they built.

relations.note: followers see the new pantheon as his creations
relations.quote: they see them as the creations of Bolas, not the true gods of Amonkhet
